summary: Quote on two NSE equities: after one is unsubscribed (a PUT) the other keeps streaming, and an event for the one let go reaches nobody.

notes: Audit appendix inherited item 3: the 5paisa XTS web adapter fixed the disconnect after an unsubscribe, as the desktop removes only the instrument let go.

deviations.reason: ltq is this web adapter's LTP name for the last quantity; the desktop sends a web key from the lowest mode it appears in upward (feed/dialect/names.rs rules), so Quote and Depth frames carry ltq beside last_quantity, where the web's Quote and Depth dicts name it last_quantity only.

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST): a wrong unit, since feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in milliseconds (1794199530000).
